title: Fed Financial Stability Report (Nov 13): AI the most-cited risk (87% of survey contacts, up from 50%); advanced-computing debt issuance about $680B by October; warns of interlinkages among data-center builders, credit markets, private lenders and SPVs; not on the BOARD until now; plus AI-financing strain titles (Broadcom $43B backstop, lenders want guarantees)
body:
# Fed Financial Stability Report (Nov 13): AI tops the risk survey; about $680B of AI-computing debt; interlinkage warning

**The report** (federalreserve.gov/publications/files/financial-stability-report-20261113.pdf; WALTER saw the URL in search, figures from secondary coverage, report body not read; data as of Oct 28):
- AI-related risk named by **87%** of the Fed's market contacts, up from **50%** in May (a survey of views, not the Fed's own measurement).
- Advanced-computing-related debt issuance about **$680B** by October 2026, about five times all of 2023 (secondary coverage); investment-grade data-center operators' bonds over $150B year to date.
- Quoted: "The complex interlinkages among firms engaged in the data center buildout, public credit markets, private lenders, and special purpose financing vehicles create vulnerabilities that necessitate close monitoring."
- Coverage also cites hedge-fund leverage at a record since 2013; one relay cites about $1T of large-bank exposure and $3T of contingent obligations, figures WALTER cannot tie to the report.

**Coverage miss:** published Thu Nov 13; no card until today. No lane search covers Fed publications by name; the 18:14Z run's gpu-obsolescence searches (newly limited to 7 days, WQ-707 A) surfaced it.

**Same theme, titles from the same run (not opened):** Broadcom's $43B AI backstop comes into focus as Redburn cuts to Neutral (Nov 14); 'Loans tighten, tech stocks plunge': Wall Street reluctant to lend even with Google guarantees, clouds over an Anthropic IPO (Nov 11); Nvidia's $500B AI financing vision 'survives, but Wall Street demands more guarantees for neoclouds' (Nov 17); data-center junk bonds $37B in 2026, nearly half of all issuance (DUP 20261110-013); CoreWeave $4B high-grade loan (DUP 20261110-011/-013); NYT: billions in insurance money bet on AI debt (DUP 20261116-007); AMRO: AI borrowing could push up global bond yields.

**For owners:** BROCK (private credit, SPVs), LIQUID (spreads), REGINALD and GIBBS (bank exposure), SHADE (insurers), VULCAN (the borrowers). WQ-622 combo:BROCK/ai-financing.
